Step:  
09-10-1101 is October 9, 1101.  
34 weeks = 34 × 7 = 238 days.  
Add 1 more day → 239 days before.  

239 days before Oct 9, 1101:  
October has 31 days.  
Go back 9 days into September → Sept 30 → 9 days back is Sept 21.  
Remaining days: 239 − 9 = 230 days earlier.  

September has 30 days, so back to Aug 22 (30 days before Sept 21).  
Remaining: 230 − 30 = 200 days earlier from Aug 22.  

200 days before Aug 22, 1101:  
July 31 (31 days), June 30 (30), May 31 (31), April 30 (30), March 31 (31), Feb 28 (28 in 1101, not leap year).  
Sum: 31+30+31+30+31+28 = 181 days (back to Feb 28).  
Remaining: 200 − 181 = 19 days before Feb 28.  

Jan 31 (31 days in Jan), so 19 days before Feb 28 → Feb 28 − 19 days = Feb 9, 1101.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1101-02-09
